answer: One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. The inspection fee is 132 POA per proof, kept either way, so 312 proofs cost the farm 41184 POA with nothing to show for a rejection. Let every applicant face the same trial with Charcoal cutter charcoal stack mark charred at the sack loft, and let the answer read as each charcoal stack is a charcoal weight weighed beside the maker's mark. The falcon points at a person the farm never met, the marble points at a sum the farm never owned, the ocean points at a year the farm never lived.
